_comment: Seed roles. The 'power_almanac_role' strings are the exact values found in the Power Almanac exports (Role column, comma-separated, multi-valued). Edit freely; custom roles need no code change. 'definition' is fed to the model, so keep it precise about CENTRAL vs departmental.

roles.label: Top Appointed Executive
roles.definition: The highest appointed (non-elected) administrator of the whole government who runs day-to-day operations for the governing body, e.g. city manager, county manager, county administrator, chief administrative officer, township administrator. Not the mayor, council chair or other elected official unless the government has no appointed executive.

roles.label: Deputy Top Appointed Executive
roles.definition: Second-tier administrators directly under the top appointed executive. Often several per government (assistant/deputy managers). Check each listed person individually.

roles.label: Head of Purchasing
roles.definition: Leads CENTRAL purchasing/procurement for the whole government. Not a departmental buyer, procurement specialist or a single department's procurement manager. In some governments this is the finance director or an internal-services director who is the legal 'Purchasing Agent'.

roles.label: Head of Finance
roles.definition: Leads the finance function for the whole government: finance director, CFO, or the treasurer/auditor/comptroller where that office is the top finance officer. If a government has separate elected treasurer and appointed finance director, prefer the appointed finance director and note the other.

roles.label: Head Clerk
roles.definition: The government's chief clerk: city/town/county/township clerk (records, council or board proceedings, elections where applicable).

roles.label: Head of IT
roles.definition: Leads information technology for the whole government (CIO, IT director, chief technology officer).

roles.label: Head of HR
roles.definition: Leads human resources / personnel for the whole government.

roles.label: Head of Communications
roles.definition: Leads public information / communications / public affairs for the whole government.

roles.label: Head of Facilities Management
roles.definition: Leads facilities / general services / building operations for the whole government.

roles.label: Head of Economic Development
roles.definition: Leads economic development for the government.

roles.label: Head of Public Works
roles.definition: Leads public works (streets, utilities, engineering) for the government.

roles.label: Head of Parks and Recreation
roles.definition: Leads parks and recreation for the government.

roles.label: Head of Planning/Zoning
roles.definition: Leads planning and zoning / community development for the government.

roles.label: Head of Geographic Information System
roles.definition: Leads GIS / mapping for the government.

roles.label: Head of Law Enforcement
roles.definition: Leads law enforcement (police chief or sheriff).

roles.label: Head of Health Services
roles.definition: Leads public health / health services for the government.

roles.label: Head of Water Supply
roles.definition: Leads water supply / utilities for the government.

roles.label: Head of Buildings
roles.definition: Leads building department / inspections / permits for the government.
